# Session Template for SESSION_LOG.md

Copy this template and fill it out at the end of each session, then add it to SESSION_LOG.md under "Session [N]".

## Quick Reference: Common Metrics to Track

**For Notebooks:**
- Total Cells
- Markdown vs Code Cells
- Checks/Tests implemented
- Pass criteria items
- Concepts covered

**For Code:**
- Functions added/modified
- Classes created
- Test coverage
- Dependencies added

**For Documentation:**
- Word count
- Sections covered
- Examples included
- Diagrams/visuals

**For Scripts:**
- Input/output formats
- Error handling
- Performance benchmarks
- Configuration options
